def has_1pos_and_kwonly(func):
    """Return True if func has at least one positional (or positional-or-keyword)
    argument and at least one keyword-only argument.
    """
    if PY2:
        spec = inspect.getargspec(func)
        pos = bool(spec.args or spec.varargs)
        kwonly = bool(spec.keywords)
    else:
        spec = inspect.signature(func)
        pos = any(p.kind in (p.POSITIONAL_ONLY, p.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD, p.VAR_POSITIONAL) for p in spec.parameters.values())
        kwonly = any(p.kind == p.KEYWORD_ONLY for p in spec.parameters.values())
    return pos and kwonly
